India clinches T20 series against Zimbabwe with 90-run win

India secured a 90-run victory over Zimbabwe in the second T20 international match in Harare, taking an unassailable 2-0 lead in the series. Ishan Kishan and Tilak Varma were key performers, with Varma scoring 60 runs off 29 balls. Captain Shreyas Iyer also contributed to the win, marking India's first T20 series victory under his captaincy. The win followed a previous series defeat against England.
